messages:
Anya: Quick check — can we do a midweek small-burst on X/LinkedIn for the launch? Want to push benchmark narrative + webinar invite. Timeline: Wed 11:00 PT (X) + Wed 14:00 PT (LinkedIn). Need asset versions + a short thread for X. Who can own editing copy?
Morgan: I can own LinkedIn copy & schedule. Can someone drop the final slide deck and hero GIF? @Ravi?
Ravi: Uploading to Google Drive now: https://drive.google.com/xyz (private). Attached: hero_v3.gif, deck_v3.pdf. I trimmed the benchmark slide to 2 bullets.
Ted: For benchmark narrative — lead with "3x latency improvement at 1/2 cost". Need a supporting stat: I'll pull the A/B test numbers from infra and draft 2 copy variants (audience vs technical).
Olivia: I'll handle engagement follow-ups + inbound routing. Suggest we route inbound replies to the SDR channel `#social-inbound` and tag messages with `webinar-interest`.
SchedulerBot: Scheduled tentative slots: X thread 2026-06-03T18:00:00Z (11:00 PT Wed), LinkedIn single post 2026-06-03T21:00:00Z (14:00 PT Wed). IDs: post_8912 / lnkd_4491
Anya: For X thread, keep top tweet short + 3 replies: stat, customer quote, CTA. Draft for approval:
```
1/ We just unlocked inference that’s 3x faster at half the cost. // short stat
2/ Proof: internal benchmark vs baseline — 150ms median @64-token sequences.
3/ See how we did it + live demo: https://redwood.ai/webinar-launch
```
Ravi: Final assets uploaded to /marketing/launch/midweek/:
- hero_v3.gif
- deck_v3.pdf
- x_thread_draft.txt
Morgan: Copy received. Scheduling via Buffer. Need final webinar landing URL with UTMs and the registration link.
Ted: Use: https://redwood.ai/webinar-launch?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=midweek_launch&utm_medium=social
Olivia: SDR routing rule (example):
```
if message contains ["demo","pricing","interested","webinar"] => tag: webinar-interest => forward to #social-inbound => assign: SDR-Team
```
Anya: Looks good. Morgan — please schedule. Olivia — can you draft the 24h DM follow-up template for replies + registrants?
Olivia: Draft DM: "Thanks for the interest! Want a quick demo or a walkthrough of the benchmark? Book 15m: https://cal.redwood.ai/15 — we'll follow up within 24h." Will add to SDR playbook.
Morgan: Done — X thread queued (post_8912). LinkedIn scheduled (lnkd_4491). I'll drop screenshots after posting. :rocket:
SchedulerBot: Confirmed posts will go live Wed 11:00 PT (X) / Wed 14:00 PT (LinkedIn). Reminders set for 30m pre-post.
Anya: Amazing — thanks team. Quick checklist: 1) assets in folder 2) copy approved 3) landing page with UTMs 4) SDR routing + DM template. We're green.
Ravi: Quick note — if we need a shorter hero GIF, I can make a 2s loop. Say if anyone wants it.
Ted: Short loop would be helpful for X. Go ahead, Ravi.
Olivia: I'll prep a follow-up Slack reminder for the SDRs 1h after posts.
Morgan: Will share post links once live.
Anya: Closing thread — will monitor engagement and pull a mini-report after 24h. :eyes:
